test_title: PYST 07: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of ::?

# : QYE :: BHP : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Given: # : QYE :: BHP : %

Option 1) # = GEU, % = RNF → GEU : QYE :: BHP : RNF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9eed4fff87123bc38fbfa86f08dd758f6a42ab6eb29329a87f4127f0b6cce59d.png] 

Option 2) # = WKK, % = LBZ → WKK : QYE :: BHP : LBZ

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a62e03d8d613e295e06d32e4faa495dcd2c72785e37a04ff5645c8d920d27d87.png] 

Option 3) # = LBZ, % = GEU → LBZ : QYE :: BHP : GEU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a965db19e92ab1434bf2efa8d8a18d5fa107ed6d83432bcc9c27d4288e4bdb1.png] 

Option 4) # = RNF, % = WKK → RNF : QYE :: BHP : WKK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5337cc8369786a89dc4d0e9d09c5f5bfc02f407c6174f1c481c24d48c00d0dec.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
